name: Tristate Electronic Manufacturing
old_description: Tristate Electronic Mfg. Inc. is a privately owned, small business, providing Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) across a multitude of industries. Industries served are Health/Medical, Aerospace/Defense, Industrial/Instrumentation, RF/Microwave, and Communications. Established in 1985, Tristate is located in Western Maryland with close proximity to the Greater Baltimore/Washington metropolitan area.
about:
Tristate Electronic Manufacturing was founded in 1985 by Ryan Null in Boonsboro, Maryland. Null, a graduate of the Arundel Institute of Technology, began the business in his home basement before moving to a facility on Old National Pike. In 1990 the company relocated to its current site at 91 Western Maryland Parkway in the Washington County Business Park near Hagerstown, positioning it within 70 minutes of two major airports and at the intersection of I‑70 and I‑81. The privately owned small business has remained under the same ownership since its inception.

The company provides electronic manufacturing services (EMS) for original equipment manufacturers, offering high‑speed surface‑mount and through‑hole circuit board assembly at low, medium, and high volumes. Capabilities include micro‑BGA placement down to 0.2 mm pitch, QFN/QFP/01005 component handling, pin‑and‑paste, automated paste and epoxy dispensing, turnkey and consigned‑kit supply‑chain management, new‑product‑introduction prototyping through production, box‑build and mechanical assembly, functional and environmental testing, HiPOT, IC programming, X‑ray inspection, automated optical inspection, conformal coating, and flying‑probe testing via third‑party partners. The facility operates under ESD controls per ANSI/ESD 20.20.

Tristate serves OEMs in health/medical, aerospace/defense, industrial/instrumentation, RF/microwave, communications, aviation, commercial, and government sectors. Its customer base spans leading technology firms that require ITAR‑registered, DFARS‑compliant manufacturing with ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 quality systems.

The company emphasizes agile, lean operations that enable quick reaction and customized solutions; a workforce with an average tenure of 14 years that brings deep experience across technology cycles; a culture of trusted integrity and straightforward communication; and a strategic location that simplifies regional logistics. Ongoing investment in workforce development keeps the team current with ISO, IPC, and industry standards.
